task_groups.title: Implement Private Helper Query and supersede_drift_findings_by_files in review_store.py

subtasks.title: Add private helper _query_active_drift_findings_for_spec to review_store.py
details: Add a module-private function _query_active_drift_findings_for_spec(conn, spec_name) in review_store.py
Execute SQL: SELECT id, artifact_ref FROM drift_findings WHERE spec_name = ? AND superseded_by IS NULL
Return a list of (id, artifact_ref) tuples
Do NOT add the function to __all__ or any public import surface
Ensure the function name starts with '_' to enforce privacy by convention

subtasks.title: Implement artifact_ref normalisation logic (line-number stripping and whitespace)
details: Implement a module-private helper _normalize_artifact_ref(ref: str) -> str
Strip trailing line-number suffix: use a regex such as r'(:\d+)+$' to remove ':N' suffixes
Strip leading/trailing whitespace after suffix removal
Return the normalised path string
This helper is used exclusively within supersede_drift_findings_by_files

subtasks.title: Implement matching logic (exact and prefix) in supersede_drift_findings_by_files
details: For each finding row returned by the private helper, skip rows where artifact_ref IS NULL (12-REQ-1.4)
Call _normalize_artifact_ref on the artifact_ref value
If normalized ref ends with '/', apply prefix matching: any(f.startswith(normalized_ref) for f in touched_files)
Otherwise apply exact matching: normalized_ref in touched_files_set (convert list to set for O(1) lookup)
Collect IDs of matching findings into a list

subtasks.title: Implement supersede_drift_findings_by_files function signature and early-exit guard
details: Define: def supersede_drift_findings_by_files(conn, spec_name: str, touched_files: list[str] | None, node_id: str) -> int
If touched_files is None or len(touched_files) == 0: log a DEBUG message and return 0 immediately — make NO database calls
Build a touched_files_set = set(touched_files) for O(1) lookup in the matching step
Export the function as part of the public review_store API (include in __all__ if it exists)

subtasks.title: Implement database update and observability logging in supersede_drift_findings_by_files
details: After collecting matching finding IDs, execute an UPDATE statement to set superseded_by = node_id for each matched ID (can batch with WHERE id IN (...))
For each superseded finding, log at INFO or DEBUG level: f'Superseded drift finding {finding_id} (artifact_ref={artifact_ref}) via session {node_id}'
Return the count of superseded findings (len of matched IDs list)
Findings with null artifact_ref or non-matching artifact_ref retain superseded_by = NULL — no UPDATE is issued for them
